reason: No candidate reviewed met all source-independence, feature-unit, and target-label compatibility requirements. No external predictions or metrics were generated.

training_dataset.name: Crop Recommendation Dataset
training_dataset.license: Apache 2.0, as declared by the publisher
training_dataset.publisher_provenance_note: The dataset page says the data was built by augmenting rainfall, climate, and fertilizer data available for India. It does not provide row-level source identifiers, augmentation lineage, or a full collection protocol.

feature_definitions.N: Nitrogen content ratio; source does not specify a physical unit.
feature_definitions.P: Phosphorus content ratio; source does not specify a physical unit.
feature_definitions.K: Potassium content ratio; source does not specify a physical unit.
feature_definitions.temperature: Degrees Celsius; temporal/measurement protocol is not specified.
feature_definitions.rainfall: Millimeters; accumulation period is not specified.

training_dataset.target_semantics: Crop label presented as a recommended/suitable crop.

candidate_dataset_assessments.name: crops-npk data set
candidate_dataset_assessments.license: MIT, as declared by the publisher

feature_description.Temperature: degrees Celsius; publisher describes atmospheric temperature

candidate_dataset_assessments.target_description: Crop type grown, with soil type and variety columns.
rejection_reasons: The publisher claims sensor/real-world data but does not identify a source institution, locations, dates, sampling protocol, sensor calibration, or row provenance; independence cannot be verified.
N/P/K are specified in mg/kg, while the training source specifies nutrient ratios without a unit or conversion basis.
The candidate describes annual rainfall while the training source does not specify the rainfall accumulation period.
Observed crop-grown labels are not demonstrated to mean crop suitability/recommendation.
Only Maize and Rice map to model classes: 6620 rows. Wheat, Potato, Tomato, and Sugarcane are unsupported: 13380 rows.
candidate_dataset_assessments.distribution_interpretation: Candidate crop counts are nearly even, but source/sampling provenance is not documented. Raw feature marginal comparisons and counts outside the training CSV's observed min/max are descriptive only; unresolved measurement units and periods prevent treating them as validated covariate-shift estimates.

candidate_dataset_assessments.name: Crop Recommendation Dataset mirror
candidate_dataset_assessments.license: Data files © Original Authors, as declared by the publisher
rejection_reasons: 1474 of 2200 feature-and-label rows exactly match the training CSV, directly disproving independence for those records.
The remaining differing rows have no independent collection provenance, so they cannot be treated as a held-out external source.

candidate_dataset_assessments.name: NPK Soil Nutrient Dataset on Horticulture Land
candidate_dataset_assessments.license: Other (specified in description); permission is not sufficiently clear from the dataset metadata
candidate_dataset_assessments.publisher_claimed_location: Horticulture lands in Padang, West Sumatra, Indonesia
rejection_reasons: The described features use soil temperature and soil moisture/humidity rather than the model's ambient temperature and relative humidity.
The described Chili, Cucumber, and Bok Choy labels are unsupported by the model and are not documented as suitability labels.
The license is not an explicit reusable license in the dataset metadata.

candidate_dataset_assessments.name: Crop Yield and Environmental Factors (2014-2023)
candidate_dataset_assessments.license: CC BY-SA 4.0, as declared by the publisher
rejection_reasons: The publisher explicitly describes this dataset as synthetic; synthetic test records are disallowed for this task.

evaluation_counts.candidate_rows_not_used_note: All rows in the detailed candidate were excluded because the dataset as a whole failed provenance and semantic compatibility checks. The 6620 rows with model-supported crop names are not a valid subset for scoring because the dataset's target meaning and units remain unverified.

compatibility_assessment.feature_names: Names can be mapped, but name matching alone does not establish semantic or unit compatibility.
compatibility_assessment.feature_units: N/P/K unit mismatch; rainfall period undefined in training source and annual in candidate.
compatibility_assessment.temperature_and_humidity: Candidate claims atmospheric temperature and humidity percent, but its source methodology is not independently documented.
compatibility_assessment.target_labels: Candidate says crop grown; training target is crop suitability/recommendation. Equivalence is not established.

overlap_audit.interpretation: Exact-value non-overlap is not proof of source independence. Provenance is insufficient, and unresolved unit/target semantics disqualify the data regardless of this check. Near-duplicate assessment was not used as a substitute for source provenance.

comparison_to_existing_dataset_level_res.scope: These are the existing training-dataset results, not external test results.

metrics.reason: No qualified, semantically compatible external test samples were available; metric calculation would be invalid.

confusion_matrix.reason: No predictions were generated for an accepted external dataset.

limitations: No independently sourced dataset with verifiable provenance, compatible physical units, and crop-suitability target semantics was identified.
The Kaggle training dataset itself is described as augmented/assembled and lacks row-level source IDs.
Exact feature-vector grouping in existing cross-validation is not source-independent validation.
No external accuracy, precision, recall, F1, per-class results, or confusion matrix can be claimed.
The existing grouped cross-validation and original row-split metrics remain dataset-level only; there is no farm/field validation.
